SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT A.TARGET, A.KEY_1, A.KEY_2 FROM ICOMTRXL A INNER JOIN IF_ADMIN B ON (1 = 1 AND B.BUYER_ID = 'SEOJ' AND B.BUYER = A.TARGET ) INNER JOIN ICOMGRDT C ON (1 = 1 AND C.BUYER = A.TARGET AND C.GR_NO = A.KEY_1 AND C.GR_SEQ = A.KEY_2 AND C.STATUS = 'D' ) WHERE DOC_NAME = 'GR_DOWN' AND KEY_9 = 'R' AND ROWNUM = 1
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT CASE WHEN A.BUYER = 'KRSEOJ0019' THEN '8230' WHEN A.BUYER = 'KRSEOJ0020' THEN '8290' WHEN A.BUYER = 'KRSEOJ0021' THEN '8220' WHEN A.BUYER = 'KRSEOJ0022' THEN '8260' WHEN A.BUYER = 'KRSEOJ0023' THEN '8270' WHEN A.BUYER = 'KRSEOJ0024' THEN '8280' WHEN A.BUYER = 'KRSEOJ0025' THEN '8210' END AS xpMroRctC_Site , F.GR_NO AS xpMroRctC_PoNbr , F.GR_SEQ AS xpMroRctC_PoLine , F.STATUS AS xpMroRctC_Status , F.ADD_DATE AS xpMroRctC_AddDate , F.ADD_TIME AS xpMroRctC_AddTime , F.CHANGE_DATE AS xpMroRctC_ModDate , F.CHANGE_TIME AS xpMroRctC_ModTime , F.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS xpMroRctC_Part , F.DESCRIPTION AS xpMroRctC_Desc , F.SPECIFICATION AS xpMroRctC_Spec , F.UNIT_MEASURE AS xpMroRctC_Um , F.ITEM_QTY AS xpMroRctC_qty_rcvd , F.UNIT_PRICE AS xpMroRctC_Price , F.ITEM_AMT AS xpMroRctC_Amt , F.GR_DATE AS xpMroRctC_Date , A.RD_DATE AS xpMroRctC_DueDate , A.PO_REMARK AS xpMroRctC_ReMark , C.ACCOUNT_TYPE AS xpMroRctC_Account , CASE WHEN A.BUYER = 'KRSEOJ0025' THEN C.BUDGET_DEPT WHEN A.BUYER = 'KRSEOJ0019' THEN '8230' WHEN A.BUYER = 'KRSEOJ0020' THEN '8290' WHEN A.BUYER = 'KRSEOJ0021' THEN '8220' WHEN A.BUYER = 'KRSEOJ0022' THEN '8260' WHEN A.BUYER = 'KRSEOJ0023' THEN '8270' WHEN A.BUYER = 'KRSEOJ0024' THEN '8280' END AS xpMroRctC_CostCentre , F_SPLIT(D.CATEG_PATH,' > ',2) AS xpMroRctC_Cat1 , F_SPLIT(D.CATEG_PATH,' > ',3) AS xpMroRctC_Cat2 , F_SPLIT(D.CATEG_PATH,' > ',4) AS xpMroRctC_Cat3 , F_SPLIT(D.CATEG_PATH,' > ',5) AS xpMroRctC_Cat4 , CASE WHEN A.BUYER = 'KRSEOJ0019' THEN '8230' WHEN A.BUYER = 'KRSEOJ0020' THEN '8290' WHEN A.BUYER = 'KRSEOJ0021' THEN '8220' WHEN A.BUYER = 'KRSEOJ0022' THEN '8260' WHEN A.BUYER = 'KRSEOJ0023' THEN '8270' WHEN A.BUYER = 'KRSEOJ0024' THEN '8280' WHEN A.BUYER = 'KRSEOJ0025' THEN '8210' END AS xpMroRctC_OrdSite , A.PO_NO AS xpMroRctC_OrdPoNbr , A.PO_SEQ AS xpMroRctC_OrdPoLine , A.ITEM_QTY AS xpMroRctC_qty_ord , 'SR13765D' AS xpMroRctC_Vend FROM ICOMGRDT F INNER JOIN ICOMPODT A ON (1 = 1 AND A.BUYER = F.BUYER AND A.PO_NO = F.PO_NO AND A.PO_SEQ = F.PO_SEQ ) INNER JOIN ICOMPRDT C ON (1 = 1 AND C.BUYER = A.BUYER AND C.PR_NO = A.PR_NO AND C.PR_SEQ = A.PR_SEQ ) INNER JOIN ICOMBYIT E ON (1 = 1 AND E.BUYER = A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AND E.BUYER_ITEM_NO = A.BUYER_ITEM_NO ) LEFT OUTER JOIN ICOMBYCA D ON (1 = 1 AND D.COM_CODE = E.BUYER AND D.STD_CATEG_ID = E.CATEGORY_NO ) WHERE F.BUYER = '$G_RS.TARGET$' AND F.GR_NO = '$G_RS.KEY_1$' AND F.GR_SEQ = '$G_RS.KEY_2$'
UPDATE ICOMTRXL A SET KEY_9 = 'Y', KEY_10 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') WHERE DOC_NAME = 'GR_DOWN' AND TARGET = '$G_RS.TARGET$' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.KEY_1$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.KEY_2$' AND KEY_9 = 'R'
UPDATE ICOMTRXL A SET KEY_9 = 'E', KEY_10) = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') WHERE DOC_NAME = 'GR_DOWN' AND TARGET = '$G_RS.TARGET$' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.KEY_1$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.KEY_2$' AND KEY_9 = 'R'
